title: The Remains of the Day
author: Kazuo Ishiguro
summary: In 1956, an ageing English butler, Stevens, takes a road trip to visit a former housekeeper. As he travels, he recalls decades of loyal service to Lord Darlington and the things he never said.
readIf: you like quiet, beautifully controlled novels where the real story lies in what the narrator avoids.
skipIf: you want plot and action, because the drama is subtle and internal.

pairings.reason: Another Ishiguro novel with a restrained narrator who slowly reveals a painful truth.
A novel about a misjudgement made in the English country-house world and its long aftermath.
A warmer, more playful story of a man whose world has shrunk but whose manners stay intact.
